open-ro.blurb: Unified Rust AI IDE for Roblox Studio with workspace Luau typechecking, symbol outline, F12 definition jump, LiveOps telemetry sync, 3-way Studio sync, prefab import, Lune sandbox, WebGL2 viewport, and ScreenGui designer (v1.29.0).

openbell.blurb: Rust Kalshi v2 research and execution terminal with causal edge checks and fail-closed risk limits (v0.9.0).

fleet.blurb: Antigravity sidebar plugin for agent swarms with atomic JSON recovery, bounded git worktree probes, RPC timeout and retry controls, conflict hunk inspection, portfolio drawer, and checkpoints (v1.31.0).

ergon.blurb: Single-binary Rust desk for employee agents with concurrent run isolation, parallel DAG branch checkpoints, step retries and subpipelines, 5-field cron with timezone, SMTPS/IMAP, MCP connectors, and client vaults (v0.39.0).

cayleb-james2008.github.io.blurb: Interactive resume, project notes, recorded walkthroughs, ten-tool /lab/ workbench, and browser previews.

credits: Sophos builds on Prime Intellect's open-source Prime Agent (PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent, MIT). OpenRO, OpenBell, and Ergon ship as cross-platform single-binary Rust desktop and web apps, and Fleet runs inside Antigravity as a sidebar plugin.
intro: I am 18 and live in Connecticut. I spent the past year building local agent software around school, work, and two years as my high school wrestling captain, often putting in 13 to 14 hours a day. Today I work full time and keep shipping OpenRO, Fleet, and Ergon alongside my existing OpenBell v0.9.0 terminal.
